stories.title: Configure Transaction Signal Thresholds for Feed Promotion
stories.goal: set thresholds for when transactions automatically get promoted to the social feed as moments
stories.benefit: I can control which transactions are significant enough to warrant feed visibility and avoid cluttering the feed with minor moves
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access transaction signal configuration from league admin dashboard
Admin can set threshold for transaction impact score that triggers auto-promotion to feed
Admin can configure separate thresholds for different transaction types: trades, adds, drops, waivers
System provides slider or numeric input for threshold values with clear impact labels (e.g., 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Major')
System shows preview of recent transactions that would/wouldn't meet current threshold settings
Changes to thresholds apply to future transactions immediately but don't affect existing moments

stories.title: Define Custom Transaction Significance Rules
stories.goal: create custom rules for what makes a transaction significant enough for feed promotion
stories.benefit: I can tailor transaction visibility to my league's specific dynamics and player values
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can enable/disable auto-promotion for specific transaction types globally
Admin can define player-specific rules (e.g., transactions involving top 10 players always promote)
Admin can set roster position rules (e.g., QB trades always promote, kicker drops never promote)
Admin can configure trade magnitude rules (e.g., 2-for-1 trades, trades involving draft picks)
System validates rules and shows warning if rules are too permissive or restrictive
Admin can test rules against historical transactions to see impact before applying

stories.title: View Transaction Signal Analytics
stories.goal: analyze which transactions are being promoted to feed and engagement patterns
stories.benefit: I can understand transaction significance patterns and refine my signal configuration for optimal feed quality
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access transaction signal dashboard showing promotion statistics
Dashboard displays: total transactions, auto-promoted transactions, promotion rate by type
Dashboard shows engagement metrics for promoted transactions (reactions, comments, views)
Admin can view list of promoted vs non-promoted transactions with their calculated significance scores
Dashboard provides recommendations for threshold adjustments based on engagement data
Admin can export transaction signal data for external analysis

stories.title: Override Auto-Promotion Decisions Manually
stories.goal: manually promote or demote transactions that were incorrectly handled by auto-promotion rules
stories.benefit: I can correct edge cases where significance scoring doesn't match actual league impact
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can view all transactions with their auto-promotion status
Admin can manually promote transactions that didn't meet threshold to create moments
Admin can demote/hide moments that were auto-promoted but aren't actually significant
System records manual overrides and uses them to improve auto-promotion algorithm
Manual promotions create moments with admin designation indicating manual curation
Admin can bulk promote/demote transactions during specific time periods (e.g., playoff trades)

stories.title: Set Time-Based Transaction Signal Adjustments
stories.goal: adjust transaction significance thresholds based on season phase
stories.benefit: I can automatically emphasize transactions during critical periods like trade deadlines and playoffs
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can define season phase periods (pre-season, regular season, trade deadline, playoffs)
Admin can set different transaction thresholds for each season phase
System automatically switches threshold settings based on current season phase
Admin can preview how current transactions would be handled in different season phases
System provides preset threshold profiles for common season phase strategies
Admin can manually override automatic phase-based adjustments if needed

stories.title: Configure Transaction Signal Notifications
stories.goal: receive notifications when significant transactions occur based on signal thresholds
stories.benefit: I can stay informed about major league moves without monitoring the feed constantly
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can enable/disable transaction signal notifications in settings
Admin can set notification threshold separate from feed promotion threshold
Admin receives immediate notification when transaction exceeds notification threshold
Notifications include transaction details and calculated significance score
Admin can choose notification delivery method (in-app, email, SMS)
System batches notifications during high-volume periods to avoid notification spam
